definition.proposition: The all-parts model A3mx (GDN hybrid + shared loop 6x2 + contractive injection + ternary MoE core + full-precision mixers and ends) improves the assembled model A2s by about 7.7% and comes within 1.4% of the full-precision assembled model A2f, but at matched active training FLOPs it trails the unshared GDN hybrid E24 by about 4.4% and does not beat dense E20 (+1.1%, CI includes 0) at 200M tokens of code-py-v2.

scope.architecture: A3mx vs A2s, A2f, E20 (dense), E24 (unshared GDN hybrid)
scope.model_size: d=384, 15.1M active / 22.2M total non-embedding params (E20 24.8M, E24 26.0M)
scope.precision: ternary MoE FFN in the core; bf16 mixers and ends

definition.refutation_criteria: REFUTED if a fresh-seed replication's paired 95% CI vs A2s includes 0, or if A3mx's CI vs E24 includes 0

qual: 3 fresh seeds, registered; competitive rule NOT met
reason: A3mx - A2s = -7.67% [-9.03, -6.28] (Holm step 2 rejects); vs A2f +1.36% [+0.09, +2.64]; vs E24 +4.35% [+2.39, +6.36]; vs E20 +1.10% [-0.70, +2.93] (seeds 5-7, df 2). Q3-Q5 all in range. The registered competitive rule (within 2% of E24 and at or below E20) is not met.

verified_at.basis: HEAD of the checkout when the event was recorded

limitations.text: Matched on active training FLOPs, not wall-clock: A3mx trains at 288k tok/s vs E24 368k and E20 586k (dense attention uses fused kernels), so per wall-clock it trails further. Per weight memory (ternary at 1.58 bits) it is the smallest: 44.0 MB vs E24 77.2 MB and E20 74.7 MB.
One horizon (200M tokens of code-py-v2): the F2 interaction flipped sign between 20M and 200M (C201 -> C202), so the gap to E24 needs a longer-horizon point (SQ380).

qual: registered results hold; LR robustness not shown; E20 not FLOP-matched
reason: Claim audit 2026-11-23-1404 (confirmed): A3mx ran at an unbracketed 6e-3 against E24/E20 at their tuned 3e-3, so A3mx's LR could explain part of its gap to E24 (policy 2.3). A3 amendment 1 (LR bracket, seed 5) decides an upgrade.

verified_at.basis: HEAD of the checkout when the event was recorded

limitations.text: E20 is not FLOP-matched: 4.01e16 training FLOPs vs A3mx's 3.79e16 (+6%, a3_runs.json 'flops'). The '+1.1% vs E20' is an inconclusive point estimate (95% CI [-0.70, +2.93], df 2), not evidence of equivalence or of 'does not beat' in a TOST sense; it only means no advantage over dense was shown.

reason: confirmed; PARTIAL pending LR bracket; E20 +6% FLOPs and inconclusive E20 wording recorded

limitations.text: The weight-memory figures (A3mx 44.0 MB at 1.58 bits per ternary weight) assume ideal 2-bit packing that has not been built or measured (BitLinear fake-quantises in bf16; SQ378). Training-time ternary is simulated, so any inference-cost reading of ternary is analytic.
